data.title: Oral Sentence Studio
data.description: Use both new words in one complete sentence of your own.

challenges.sceneMeaning: The helpful boy is gentle and careful with the green plants in the sunny garden.
acceptedSentences: Be gentle and careful when holding the little bird.
The teacher is careful and gentle with the wet paint.
Puppies need a gentle and careful hand to feel safe.
challenges.storyText: The helpful boy works in the sunny garden. He is very gentle and careful with every single leaf.

challenges.sceneMeaning: The kind girl is careful when giving water to the thirsty sprout in the sunny garden.
acceptedSentences: Be careful so the thirsty plant does not spill.
That thirsty puppy wants a careful bath.
A careful turtle walks by the thirsty grass.
challenges.storyText: The kind girl is careful with the watering can. She gives cool water to the thirsty sprout.

challenges.sceneMeaning: The smiling child is gentle with the tiny seeds in the garden.
acceptedSentences: Be gentle when you hold a tiny bug.
The tiny bird sits on a gentle breeze.
That tiny kitten needs a gentle touch.
challenges.storyText: The smiling child is very gentle with the tiny seeds. They place each seed in the small pot.
